thread:
Arjun Rao: Quick heads-up — ran a full perf/cpu profile on staging after yesterday's kernel-selector change. Overall throughput looks fine but token-level latencies increased ~18% p50->p95 for the long-seq suite. KV hit-rate is unchanged, so not a cache miss problem.

Emma Chen: ugh. any obvious hotspot in the flamegraphs?

Arjun Rao: yeah — the token breakdown shows a clear shift: matmul/compute time climbed, and the profiler points to a new kernel variant being picked a lot more often. The metric that tipped us off was token_compute_ms with a kernel_name label — we suddenly have 30-40 distinct kernel_name values across the same model/sequence length because selector now includes shard_id/tiling params in the name.

Jamie L: that's the cardinality trap. kernel_name is too fine-grained for time-series. We should canonicalize into kernel_family + kernel_variant (small finite set) and keep kernel_version as a short semver if needed.

Liam Ortiz: agree. Also we need per-token-stage labels (kv_lookup, kv_cache_miss, attention, matmul, softmax) so dashboards can show which stage regressed. Right now token_total_ms hides the distribution.

Arjun Rao: proposed changes:
- drop high-cardinality kernel_name from TS ingest.
- emit kernel_family (examples: matmul_sharded, matmul_unsharded, attention_fused) and kernel_variant (int8, fp16, tiled) 
- add metrics_schema_version = "v2" label on new metrics so dashboards can switch.
- add token_stage label with canonical enum values: kv_lookup, kv_fetch, kv_hit, kv_miss, attention, matmul, postproc.

Emma Chen: sounds good. Do we plan to backfill or dual-write? We need a migration plan for existing Grafana panels and alert rules.

Jamie L: dual-write for 2 weeks: keep emitting old kernel_name (for a grace period) but mark new metrics with metrics_schema_version=v2 and kernel_family/variant. After 2 weeks we drop old label. Also at ingest we should map the many kernel strings to canonical families — a small mapping table maintained in the observability service.

Liam Ortiz: +1. For alerts: switch alerts to operate on the new labels but keep old ones active until cutover. Also create a migration dashboard showing divergence between old and new label aggregations, and a per-route token_p50/p90/p99 comparison.

Arjun Rao: example PromQLs we can add to dashboards (pseudo):
```
# per-route token p95, grouped by token_stage
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{schema="v2"}[5m])) by (le, route, token_stage))

# kernel family breakdown of token compute time
sum(rate(token_compute_seconds_sum{schema="v2"}[5m])) by (route, kernel_family) / sum(rate(token_compute_seconds_count{schema="v2"}[5m])) by (route)
```

Emma Chen: Also limit cardinality in ingestion: refuse > 50 distinct kernel_variant values per model per hour and tag excess ones as "other". That keeps TSDB sane.

Jamie L: recommend naming conventions: snake_case labels, short names (<=32 chars), avoid embedding ids. kernel_family and token_stage enums should be documented in the metrics README and pinned in source. Also publish a tiny compatibility script that maps old kernel_name -> kernel_family for historical dashboards.

observability-bot: note created: metrics-migration/kernels -> owner: observability, deadline: 2026-04-02.

Liam Ortiz: one more thing — routing/fallback impacts. If smart-routing is falling back to a cheaper model variant under load, we need a route-level routing_reason label so per-route KPIs can show if fallback was happening during regression windows.

Arjun Rao: good call. add routing_reason enum: normal, fallback_capacity, fallback_cost, pinned.

Jamie L: to summarize action items:
- observability: implement canonicalization mapping and dual-write (obs team)
- eng-runtime: add kernel_family/kernel_variant emissions + token_stage split at the runtime layer
- dashboards: add migration panels + new p50/p90/p99 per-route breakdowns (devex + obs)
- SRE/alerts: mirror alert rules and set a 2-week watchdog before dropping old labels

Emma Chen: I'll own the dashboards and migration panels. Arjun/Jamie can coordinate the mapping table. Liam can handle alert mirroring.

Arjun Rao: thanks. I'll open a PR with the runtime changes and a small mapping prototype. Will include sample queries and a short backwards-compat plan in the PR description.

deploy-bot: rollout paused: kernel-selector/experiment-7 — 1 failing healthcheck in staging.

Arjun Rao: leaving the experiment paused until we validate after metric schema changes and a quick canary with the canonicalized kernels. :thumbsup:

Jamie L: +1. After migration, we should run a 72h synthetic replay job to ensure no regressions in token_stage distribution.

Emma Chen: copied notes to obs/migrations/kernels.md and added the schema draft. I'll share the link in this thread once it's live. :spiral_note_pad:
